canada.title: Canada
canada.description: Statutory withholding for Canadian pay runs, remittances, and year-end.
canada.edition: {edition, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} edition (effective {effective})
canada.coverage: All provinces & territories. Quebec: QPP, QPIP, and the federal side; provincial income tax is administered by Revenu Québec and is not included.
canada.components: Statutory pay components: base pay, overtime, bonus, vacation, income tax, CPP, EI, QPIP.

us.title: United States
us.description: Federal statutory withholding for US pay runs: income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and unemployment.
us.engine: IRS Pub 15-T percentage-method engine (2026) with W-4 Steps 2–4 and pre-2020 allowances.
us.coverage: Federal plus the nine no-withholding states (AK, FL, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY). State income tax withholding ships in a later wave.
us.components: Statutory pay components: federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare (incl. Additional Medicare), FUTA, and SUI.
us.config: SUI rates and wage bases are experience-rated per employer — enter yours under Accounts & posting.

packs.uninstallConfirm: Remove this pack’s statutory components and switch off its withholding engine? Uninstalling is blocked while employees or payroll records still depend on the pack.

packAccounts.none: No payroll country pack is installed yet, so there are no statutory withholding accounts to configure.

CA.title: Canada — CRA statutory accounts
CA.description: Liability accounts for the amounts the CRA pack withholds and accrues. Each choice applies to every component the slot covers (employee and employer sides together).

US.title: United States — federal statutory accounts
US.description: Liability accounts for the amounts the US pack withholds and accrues. Each choice applies to every component the slot covers (employee and employer sides together).

usConfig.title: Unemployment rates
usConfig.description: FUTA and state unemployment are employer-paid. SUI rates are experience-rated per employer, so they are entered here, never assumed.
usConfig.futaRateHelp: As a decimal: 0.006 is the standard 0.6% after the full state credit. Raise it for credit-reduction states.
usConfig.suiHelp: One row per state you employ in: your assessed rate as a decimal (0.027 = 2.7%) and the state’s taxable wage base.

remittances.title: Payroll remittances
